name: Seiko Tanaka
source: Seiko is cheerful, outspoken, and a bit sassy. One of her biggest traits is her optimism and determination, always wanting to try her best at everything she produces (Be it her YouVideo content, her dance practice, or anything else). Her main interests are anime, video games, and music, she also has a love for food (particularly soda and junk food). Her stage name is Clover.
